swaps.retire_text: Assertion (A): Two rectangles can have the same perimeter but different areas. Reason (R): Perimeter depends only on the sum of the sides, while area depends on how the length and breadth are combined by multiplication.

add.a: A is false, R is true
o: A is false, R is true
